chunks: So, I warn you of the blazing Fire.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by the 'blazing Fire' in Surah Al-Layl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) duty of *tanbih* (alerting) as a divine mandate, linking the visceral description of 'Talaṣṣā' (flaming fire) to the spiritual consequences of rejecting the Imams and the Ahl al-Bayt. The intensity of the fire serves as a metaphor for the burning regret of those who ignored the clear guidance (*bayyinah*) provided through the Prophet and his progeny.
